option_relations.rationale: The option describes bacterial skull base osteomyelitis secondary to complicated rhinosinusitis, which is not directly related to Cavernous sinus thrombosis.
The option describes CN7 paresis secondary to acute bacterial sinusitis, which is not directly related to Cavernous sinus thrombosis.
The option describes an orbital abscess secondary to bacterial rhinosinusitis, which is not directly related to Cavernous sinus thrombosis.
The option describes chronic rhinosinusitis with orbital cellulitis/abscess, which is not directly related to Cavernous sinus thrombosis.
